2. The apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising:

a second exhaust port (165a) that is open to the outside of the diaphragm pump; and a second exhaust passage (165) configured to make the second exhaust port communicate with the area in the discharge passage between the fluid outlet of the discharge valve and the fluid discharge port.
3. The apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the second exhaust passage is always open.
4. The apparatus according to claim 2 or 3, wherein a width of the second exhaust port is smaller than a width of the fluid discharge port.
5. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 4, further comprising:

a fluid passage (B) configured to make the discharge passage communicate with a pressurization target object (A); and a pressure sensor (105) configured to detect a pressure in the fluid passage, wherein the control device is configured to control the rotational speed based on the pressure detected by the pressure sensor.

6. The apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the control device is configured to control the rotational speed and regulate the pressure not only when the pressure is increased, but also when the pressure is decreased.
